title: Registration for the Swiss Research Data Day 2018 (SRDD2018) is now open. #SRDD2018 will gather notable speakers to discuss practices around handling, managing, and sharing research data. In addition, you can showcase your own work as a poster and network with colleagues.
main_content:
Registration for the Swiss Research Data Day 2018 (SRDD2018) is now open. #SRDD2018 will gather notable speakers to discuss practices around handling, managing, and sharing research data. In addition, you can showcase your own work as a poster and network with colleagues.

As a project partner in DLCM (Digital Lifecycle Management) ETH Library's Digital Curation Office supports this event in terms of content and organization.
